Start with the early core (Stridebreaker, then Sundered Sky) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. kitEvidence.formula:
Volibear transforms and leaps, gaining [175 / 350 / 525] Health and [50] Attack Range for the next [12] seconds.

Upon landing, Volibear cracks the earth, Disabling nearby towers for [2 / 3 / 4] seconds and dealing [300 / 500 / 700 + (1.25) × AP + (2.5) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to them. Nearby enemies are Slowed by [50]%, decaying over 1 second. Enemies directly underneath Volibear suffer [300 / 500 / 700 + (1.25) × AP + (2.5) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage.

Volibear gains [0.12 / 0.155 / 0.19 / 0.225 / 0.26] Move Speed, doubled to [0.24 / 0.31 / 0.38 / 0.45 / 0.52] towards enemy champions for the next [4] seconds. While active, Volibear's next Attack deals [10 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 + (1) × AD + (1.6) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage and Stuns the target for [1] second.

Volibear becomes enraged if an enemy Immobilizes him before he Stuns a target, ending the Ability early but refreshing its Cooldown.

Volibear gains [0.05 + (0.0004) × AP] Attack Speed for [6] seconds whenever he deals damage with an Ability or Attack, stacking up to 5 times.

At 5 stacks, Volibear's claws ignite with lightning, causing his Attacks to deal an additional [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=11, perLevel=1, changes=[{"mLevel": 4, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 2.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 7, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 3.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 14, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 4.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.45) × AP + (0.2) × AD[statFormula=2]] magic damage to the target and 4 closest enemies.

Volibear mauls an enemy, dealing [5 / 30 / 55 / 80 / 105 + (1.1) × AD + (0.06) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] physical damage and marking them for [8] seconds.

If this Ability is used on a marked target, its damage is increased to [(5 / 30 / 55 / 80 / 105 + (1.1) × AD + (0.06) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]) × ((1.5 + (0.0025) × AD[statFormula=2]))] and Volibear restores [20 / 35 / 50 / 65 / 80] plus [0.08 / 0.11 / 0.14 / 0.17 / 0.2] missing Health.

Volibear summons a thundercloud that fires a lightning bolt, dealing [80 / 110 / 140 / 170 / 200 + (0.7) × AP] plus [(0.11 / 0.12 / 0.13 / 0.14 / 0.15) × 100]% max Health magic damage and Slowing by [40]% for [2] seconds.

If Volibear is inside the blast zone, he gains a [(0.75) × AP] plus [14]% max Health Shield for [3] seconds.
